title: A Voidborn hauler done with the Solarian once lines joins the Crimson corridor: one trip to Krynn War Citadel, where Last Known Position and Strategic Readiness Assessment open to it (a test, three ships)
note: Written by Apollo, 2026-11-23 12:29 UTC (orders ENT-082, block APOLLO: the capitals' once lines by join corridors, Trade's pattern join-krynn-trader; rules F3, F8, F34 tier 4, F37). Road: Alpha Centauri to Krynn 20 jumps, Sol to Krynn 19 (fuelplan chart, tank 45 of 95), flown by Trade's join-krynn-trader three times (table runs, last 11:36 UTC).
